title: Coast Guard Rescue Swimmers Demonstrate Importance of Life Jackets
description: Two Coast Guard rescue swimmers from Coast Guard Sector San Diego spend a couple hours in the water to demonstrate the importance of wearing a life jacket and how the ocean and cold water affect them. Coast Guard video by Petty Officer 3rd Class Connie Gawrelli.
